tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The app's page ground (white cards sit on it) and the inner well of every product frame.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables, inputs, menus and the selected tab everywhere; the setup and onboarding page ground.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: the tab track, code blocks, table header rows, hover on secondary and ghost buttons, the muted card, skeletons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every soft edge: card and frame borders, table rules, dividers and the resting edge of every form control (inputs, selects, textareas, chip inputs, the Agent composer, the CSV file input, checkbox and radio boxes; D5, D46), with shadow-edge under a field. A divider inside a dialog or the search palette is line, never darker, and line is the 3px halo around a focused field.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: One soft step darker than line: a form control's hover edge (D46) and the dashed edge of reserved slots (the new-workspace tile).

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Marks that need 3:1 but are not borders: the chart crosshair, the Switch's off track, the ink TextLink underline, the StepList pending ring and a not-cited engine mark. Never the edge of a control (that is line), card or box.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, primary text and numbers on paper, surface, surface-sunken and every -soft tint (accent-soft, positive-soft, negative-soft, warning-soft, info-soft): callout bodies are ink. Also the primary button fill and the inverted tile.

tokens.name: ink-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Leads and secondary copy, descriptions, unselected tabs, nav links. On paper, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, eyebrows, placeholders, timestamps, footnotes. On paper, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill: the primary button label, the inverted tile.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Flare, the only hue: the logo bars and "Cite", active rungs, your own brand's citation number and chart series, the selected nav marker in the app. A mark, never body text, a button fill or a background.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as text: inline links inside long reading copy (reports, rendered Markdown). On paper, surface and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind ink: the highlighter mark and your own brand's citation pill or table row.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill (the own-brand citation number). Always dark: white on Flare fails contrast.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring, 2px offset, in ink. Passes 3:1 on paper, surface and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Gains, healthy checks, "cited", success toasts. Teal, so it never relies on red versus green alone. Text on paper, surface and positive-soft; always beside an arrow, icon or word.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Background of positive badges and success callouts.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Losses, failed checks, errors, destructive actions. Text on paper, surface and negative-soft; always beside an arrow, icon or word.

tokens.name: negative-soft
tokens.usage: Background of negative badges and error callouts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention, partial data, stale results, expiring credentials. Text on paper, surface and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges and callouts.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information callouts and "note" admonitions. Text on paper, surface and info-soft; never decorative.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info callouts.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: First chart series: your brand.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series: the leading competitor or the total.

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series. Past three series, draw the rest as one "Other" series in line-control and label it.

tokens.name: data-other
tokens.usage: The "Other" series and slice, always textured (dashed line, hatched area) and labelled, so it never reads as a fourth brand.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The backdrop behind dialogs, drawers and the command palette. Nothing else.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and axis baselines. Decorative.

styles.name: display-2xl
styles.sample: Get cited when buyers ask AI
styles.usage: The largest display heading, one per page; 36/42 from 768 to 1023px, with no tracking on Cal Sans.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Display section headings (h2). 28/34 below 768px.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: The setup and onboarding card titles (AuthHead). 26/32 below 768px.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Long-form h2 and the heading of a section that is one split.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: The app's PageHeader title, the only Cal Sans in the app (D7, D11), in a 40px title row with the actions centred on it.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Not used by the app's screens; kept as a rung of the type ladder. Never in the app: there Cal Sans is the PageHeader title only (D7).

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Captions under product frames and long-form h3.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: CiteLadder runs the questions your buyers ask ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, and shows which pages each answer cites.
styles.usage: The lead paragraph under a display or section heading, in ink-secondary. 18/28 below 768px.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Each prompt runs every morning on every engine you track.
styles.usage: Long-form body copy (prose).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Three of your five product pages were cited last week.
styles.usage: Body copy in reading surfaces and card descriptions.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: The app's default text: tables, forms, cards, menus.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, field labels, nav items, group heads.

styles.name: label-lg
styles.usage: Large (control-lg) buttons and the website navbar links.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: App card titles, settings section titles and table group headings. Geist never goes above 500 (D6).

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Dialog and drawer titles and the billing plan name: the app's larger heading, in Geist because Cal Sans in the app is the PageHeader title only (D7). On the website, card, step, form and tool titles and article h3 (D28).

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The number in a Stat and a KpiRow card. Geist 500 since D7 (5 Nov 2026), 28/36 since D15; the ScoreRing and DonutChart centres use the same face at 32/38.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Chart axes and footnotes, helper text under fields.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a heading or a stat. Never a sentence.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Deltas, dates, IDs a person reads, citation numbers, inline code.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks in docs, blog and product frames.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge dot gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; product frame padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (md); list row padding; the app's card gap (D11).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: App card padding (D11); the app page's top padding and the header-to-controls gap; field stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter below 768px; frame caption padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The app page's side padding from 1280px; caption padding inside a product frame.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Heading-to-content gap in a display section.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page gutter 768–1279px.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between a section header and its grid.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page gutter from 1280px.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between display sections below 1024px.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between display sections from 1024px.

tokens.name: radius-2xs
tokens.usage: Chart bars, legend swatches, rungs.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, favicons, checkboxes, the highlighter mark, meter and progress tracks. Only slightly rounded everywhere (D10, 5 Nov 2026).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tabs inside a track, menu items, small icon buttons, tooltips, citation pills, the announcement pill.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, the tab track, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: App cards and panels, menus, dialogs, the inner well of a product frame.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Product frames. The largest radius in the system: nothing is rounded past 8px (D10).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only avatars, status dots, switch tracks (and their thumb), count pills (footnote numbers, nav counts) and the radio circle. Never a pill-shaped button, chip, citation or bar (D10).

shadow.note: Depth is quiet: a hairline ring plus a short, soft drop. App cards use shadow-card; fields and checkbox boxes use a 1px line border with shadow-edge.

tokens.name: shadow-edge
tokens.usage: The faint smudge under a form control's soft line edge (D5, D46): inputs, textareas, search fields, select triggers, chip inputs, checkbox and radio boxes, the Agent composer. No ring of its own, so the 1px border stays the only edge; shadow-xs would double it.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, the selected tab, citation pills.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: App cards and panels on paper; screens inside a product frame.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts, the mega menu, a floating card inside a product frame.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: The primary (ink) button, a raised key (D29): a top highlight, a bottom inner shade, a tight drop and a soft lift.

control.note: Control heights. Every interactive row in one view uses the same height.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: The app's compact controls: dense tables, toolbar buttons, citation pills.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: App buttons, inputs, selects, the tab track, sidebar rows. 32 since D11 (5 Nov 2026), GitHub-style density.

tokens.name: row-app
tokens.usage: App table rows, and the project switcher and PageHeader title row that align across the sidebar and the page (D11).

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The command palette's search row and large setup controls.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: The setup and onboarding top bar.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The app sidebar, expanded.

layout.note: Content widths. Gutters are space-5 below 768px, space-10 to 1279px, space-16 from 1280px.

tokens.name: container-app
tokens.usage: Max width of an app page's content inside the shell.

tokens.name: container-prose
tokens.usage: A long reading column.

tokens.name: container-narrow
tokens.usage: Centred section headers, setup cards, onboarding steps, empty states.
